title: Lipschitz comparison from fourth derivative bounds
statement:
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$ be probability spaces, and let $U\in L^4(\mu)$ and $V\in L^4(\nu)$. Suppose $B\ge0$ and, for every $C^4$ function $\phi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ and every $C\ge0$ such that $|\phi^{(4)}(t)|\le C$ for all $t\in\mathbb R$, assume
\[
\left|\int \phi(U)\,d\mu-\int \phi(V)\,d\nu\right|\le CB.
\]
Then for every $c\ge0$ and every $c$-Lipschitz function $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$,
\[
\left|\int \psi(U)\,d\mu-\int \psi(V)\,d\nu\right|\le16cB^{1/4}.
\]
